generation.domain: nonsingular real linear system; no exchanges; integer entries

question.:question/problem:
Consider the augmented matrix

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 2 \\ -2 & -2 & -1 & 8\end{array}\right].
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The augmented matrix is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 2 \\ -2 & -2 & -1 & 8\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3+2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 1 & -2 \\ 0 & 1 & -2 & 2 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 4\end{array}\right].
$$

The matrix is in row echelon form: each pivot lies to the right of the pivot above it, with zeros below each pivot.

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 2 & -2 & -2 & 2\end{array}\right].
$$

question.:question/worked-solution:

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 2 & -2 & -2 & 2\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3-2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & -2 & -6\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=-\frac{1}{2}R_3$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & -1 & 0 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & 0 & -1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 3\end{array}\right].
$$

The matrix is in row echelon form: each pivot lies to the right of the pivot above it, with zeros below each pivot.

question.:question/problem:
Consider the system of linear equations

$$
\left\{\begin{aligned}x+y+2z&=4 \\ -2x-y-5z&=-7 \\ 2x+2y+3z&=8\end{aligned}\right..
$$

Use the standard method of Gaussian elimination to reduce the augmented matrix $M$ of the system to row echelon form.
question.:question/worked-solution:
The augmented matrix is

$$
M=\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 2 & 4 \\ -2 & -1 & -5 & -7 \\ 2 & 2 & 3 & 8\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_2:=R_2+2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 2 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & 1 \\ 2 & 2 & 3 & 8\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=R_3-2R_1$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 2 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & -1 & 0\end{array}\right].
$$

Using $R_3:=-1R_3$, we obtain

$$
\left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 1 & 2 & 4 \\ 0 & 1 & -1 & 1 \\ 0 & 0 & 1 & 0\end{array}\right].
$$

The matrix is in row echelon form: each pivot lies to the right of the pivot above it, with zeros below each pivot.
